Anna L: Quick sync request — we need a proposal for per-model/route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Planning doc due EOD Friday, can we align on what runtime/infra metrics we need?
Jordan C: +1. Do you want these split by model version and route? also region and deployment tier?
Anna L: Yes: model, route, model_version, region, deployment_tier (hosted/dedicated/private). Keep cardinality in mind.
Mike R: For latency: I suggest we surface raw histogram counters from runtime and compute P50/P95/P99 in the dashboard layer. That keeps metric ingestion light.
Priya S: Histogram ingestion increases cardinality. If we keep only summaries (quantiles) we lose accuracy but save cost. Tradeoff.
Jordan C: Can we expose both: coarse quantiles at high-cardinality labels, full histograms at lower-cardinality rollups? e.g., per-model-version limited to top 50 models.
Mike R: Yes — runtime can emit `route_latency_ms_bucket{le="...",model=...,route=...}` for low-cardinality and `route_latency_ms_quantile{quantile="0.95"}` for global view.
DevEx: UX note: Console wants TTFT (time-to-first-token) at the gateway and at the runtime level. Gateway TTFT captures network/queueing; runtime TTFT isolates model startup/kv-cache effects.
Anna L: Important: TTFT definition must be consistent. Propose: gateway_ttft_ms measured at API gateway when first token byte sent; runtime_ttft_ms measured from request arrival at runtime to first token emitted.
Jordan C: Agree. Also need tokens/sec as an instantaneous throughput and also a 1m/5m avg. Metric names: `tokens_inferred_total` (counter) + rate() for tokens/sec in graphs.
Mike R: Sample PromQL for tokens/sec panels: ```rate(tokens_inferred_total{model=~".*",route=~".*"}[1m])```
Priya S: Retention/cost: if we keep 5s resolution histograms for all labels across all regions, storage will blow up. Propose 1m resolution for high-cardinality, 15s for host-critical models.
Anna L: We also need TTL on high-cardinality time series and an automated selector for which models get higher res based on traffic. SRE?
SRE Bot: @channel Incident note: last week we saw a 3x spike in time-series cardinality after a canary - tagging anomaly. Recommend default label whitelist.
Jordan C: Action items: 1) Mike to PR runtime metric names + example payloads by Tue. 2) Priya to estimate storage cost for 3 retention/resolution tiers by Wed. 3) Jordan to prototype Grafana dashboard skeleton (panels: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT gateway/runtime, tokens/sec, concurrency, error-rate) by Thu.
Mike R: I'll also add a flag to toggle emitting full histograms per deployment_tier.
Priya S: I'll include cost numbers and a recommended default (1m, 30d) and premium (15s, 90d).
DevEx: Console UX asks for rollout toggles — can we add a drop-down to switch model_version on the dashboard and a canary overlay?
Jordan C: Grafana should be able to query `{model_version=~"v.*"}` and overlay canary traffic using a `deployment_tag` label.
Anna L: Perfect. One more: include example queries and a tiny data dictionary in the doc — we want on-call and product to understand definitions.
Jordan C: Will add sample queries + glossary.
Anna L: Thanks everyone — I'll collate into the doc and ping infra/product for review. :thumbsup:
